item.title: Bruno Mars’ new video honors Catholic marriage
item.description: The 16x Grammy-winning pop star Bruno Mars released his first solo album in nearly a decade last week. ‘The Romantic’ is causing a stir on social media where Catholics in particular are sharing his video ‘Risk it All,’ which has many scenes shot in a Catholic Church and is clearly honoring the sacrament of marriage.
